records.authority_and_privacy_finding: Consequential actions: publishing to Hugging Face (`rskill_publisher.py --publish`), uploading via `quantize_rskill.py` (uploads by default unless --skip-upload), and executing remote model code (`--trust-remote-code` with OPENRAL_ALLOW_REMOTE_CODE=1). Gates are technical: 'Dry-run first', 'Publish only after validation passes', env-var acknowledgement for remote code. There is no explicit stop for user approval before publish/upload. Static read of tools/quantize_rskill.py shows `_upload` calls `api.create_repo(..., private=False)` (line ~599), so the SKILL.md command `HF_TOKEN=<token> uv run python tools/quantize_rskill.py --source <source> --target <owner>/rskill-<id> --policy-class <module.Class>` (no --skip-upload) would create a PUBLIC repo and upload, contradicting the reference's publish gate 'Repo is private at upload time' and 'publisher creates private repos only'. Remote code: transformers custom code executes `modeling_*.py` from the source repo, gated by trusted-org list or env flag only.
